stem: Meera is packing her lunch for school on a hot summer afternoon. Which choice best supports healthy eating?

options.text: A very large serving of fresh, wholesome rice and dal, because wholesome food is always healthy in any amount
A moderate portion of fresh vegetable pulao with curd, suited to the hot weather and her afternoon mealtime
A brightly coloured packet of fried chips and a sweet drink, because the colourful meal looks attractive
Her favourite tasty sweets only, because familiar and tasty food is always a healthy choice

teacher.key_rationale: Healthy eating requires wholesome food in moderate quantity, suited to season, time, and place. Only option B satisfies all three conditions; A ignores moderation, C confuses appearance with health, and D relies only on familiarity and taste.
